The '''Trevi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Quess sector/Legends|Quess sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], close to several [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]]. It contained at least four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Trevi IV]].
